method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a square garden split by one vertical and one horizontal segment into four rectangles: P is top-left, F is top-right, L is bottom-left, and S is bottom-right. From the text, convert the square lawn perimeter 20 m to side length 5 m, and the square flowerbed perimeter 12 m to side length 3 m. Since L is the bottom-left square, the entire left column has width 5 m; since F is the top-right square, the entire top row has height 3 m. Therefore pool P, occupying the top-left rectangle, has dimensions 5 m by 3 m. Its perimeter is 2(5+3)=16 m.
